cd /app/tmp && timeout 170 python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random, ctypes, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_pipeline as sp, scamp_accel
rng = random.Random(4242)
# biggest legitimate image: 2048 rules, S=16, ms=32
fib = gen_fib(rng, 2048, 'mixed')
req = {'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':sp.canon_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
       'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}
line = json.dumps(req, separators=(',',':'))
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=line+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
img = json.loads(p.stdout)
assert img['status']=='ok', img['status']
addrs = [sp.canon_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
lk = json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs}, separators=(',',':'))
print('compile line bytes', len(line), 'lookup line bytes', len(lk))
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/app/submit/_scamp_helper.so')
lib.json_prescan.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_int,
                           ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_long), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
for name, data in [('compile', line.encode()), ('lookup', lk.encode())]:
    v = ctypes.c_long(0); d = ctypes.c_int(0)
    rc = lib.json_prescan(data, len(data), 10**9, 10**6, ctypes.byref(v), ctypes.byref(d))
    print(name, 'values', v.value, 'depth', d.value, 'rc', rc)
EOF
